edges.text: Participation in Electrical Measurement Methods and Mechanics HI with at least 1 credit passed from each course. Participation in Medical Measurement Methods and Electronics.
Participation in Single Variable Calculus or Calculus for Engineers. Participation in Linear Algebra I, Algebra and Geometry or Algebra and Vector Geometry.

60 credits in science/engineering. Introduction to Biomedical Engineering. Human-Computer Interaction. Scientific Computing. Computer Programming. At least 2 credits from each of the courses Regulatory Systems, Patient Safety and Ethics and Biomedical Sensor Technology.

Participation in a course in programming in Python (for example Computer Programming I), or the course can be taken in parallel. Participation in one of the courses Single Variable Calculus, Single Variable Calculus M, Geometry and Calculus and Calculus for Engineers.
General entry requirements and Mathematics Further level 1c, or Mathematics 3c/Mathematics D
15 credits in science/engineering. Participation in the introductory course for one of the Faculty's programmes.
Introduction to Biomedical Engineering and one credit in Electrical Measurement Methods.
120 credits including 60 credits in science/engineering/medicine/pharmacy/business administration. Proficiency in English equivalent to the Swedish upper secondary course English 6.
